format: UTF-8 JSONL; each row has one final audio file
parents: list of original ancestors; Mixed exactly two; keep speaker/track/PCM hash when known; propagate derivative ancestry

base_exposure.upstream: yes/no/unknown, never inferred from CSV absence
base_exposure.evidence: nonempty list of evidence references covering all ancestors

labels: 0/1 or null; mask 0 excludes label even when numeric 0; composition RR/FR/RF/FF uses voice/music order
identity_requirement: code/checkpoint/audio/preprocessing/numeric-mode identity in extended cache; current supplied snapshot hashes pinned
registry_caveat: no conflict is not proof of novel source/upstream data
